headline: Market closed today; in last trading session Sensex fell 289 points while indices logged weekly gains.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Retreat in global AI stocks fueled a great rotation trade into Indian equities.
FII buying supported Indian equities to achieve a third straight weekly gain.
Inflation concerns weighed on sentiment during Friday's trading session.
Strong weekly performance in smallcaps (+3.6%) and PSU banks (+7.5%) boosted overall market momentum.
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed today, Sunday, 15 November 2026, for the weekend.
In the last session on Friday, 13 November, Sensex slipped 289 points alongside Nifty.
Despite Friday's decline, Sensex and Nifty recorded gains for the third consecutive week.
FIIs turned net buyers amid positive Q2 earnings performance.
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today, Sunday, for the weekend and reopens on Monday, 16 November. In the last session, the Sensex fell 289 points as inflation worries resurfaced. However, Indian benchmark indices secured their third straight weekly gain, aided by FII inflows and sector rotation from AI stocks.
